info.name: Kahoots Gateway
info.description:
Every API of every microservice, called through the API Gateway with `Authorization: Bearer {{jwt}}`.

1. Run `bash db-scripts/seed-all.sh` (after `docker compose up -d`).
2. Import `postman/kahoots-local.postman_environment.json` and select **Kahoots Local (seeded)**.
3. Send any request: the ids in the environment point at seeded, real data.

The token, the user and all ids come from the environment. If the token is missing or expired, it is refreshed automatically by logging in as `{{username}}`. Create requests store the new id in a `created*` variable, and the matching update/delete requests use it, so seeded data is never deleted.

exec: body: { mode: 'raw', raw: JSON.stringify({ username: pm.environment.get('username'), password: pm.environment.get('password') }) }
